decisions.reason: In a countdown control, the time value already supplies the unit/context; 'Còn {0}' preserves the remaining-time meaning with far less width.
The donation screen already supplies the item context; removing the repeated noun keeps the completed donated count and preserves {0}.
The label specifically counts invited people rather than invitations; the current wording is clear and safer than a shorter ambiguous form.
This is a compact time-until-end label; 'Còn lại' carries the same countdown role without the sentence-like ending phrase.
The source does not identify whose donation is absent; shorter natural alternatives would risk changing this into a user-specific or no-records statement.
On the item-request screen, the item noun is redundant; the concise empty-state message preserves that no requests currently exist.
The no-race empty state is natural and semantically explicit; available shorter forms are awkward or depend on missing screen context.
The donated-state label is natural and only marginally above a tiny-chip heuristic; no rewrite is warranted.
For an unaffiliated status, 'Chưa có CLB' is natural, compact, and preserves that the player currently belongs to no club.
The monthly club-ranking header is clear, preserves {0}, and remains within the normal header/dialog budget.
As a recruitment-section title, the surrounding screen supplies the informational framing; the direct member-recruitment label is much more compact.
The club-introduction label is natural and already within the normal tab/button budget.
The direct UI verb 'Sửa' removes unnecessary verbal length while preserving that the club introduction is being edited.
The compact state 'Chưa xếp hạng' naturally expresses that no ranking is available and removes the wider existential phrase.
The out-of-rank status is concise and already fits the tiny/pill budget.
The shorter title retains the ranking-publication event while removing the redundant 'kết quả' noun from a ranking context.
Vietnamese can express the no-reward state compactly as 'Không có thưởng'; the removed 'phần' adds width without changing the operational meaning.
The invite-member action is natural and already within the normal button budget.
The current phrase is literal and over-wide; 'Chiến thắng chính' naturally labels the major-win history while retaining the win concept.
The standard compact warning 'Thiếu nguyên liệu' preserves the insufficient-material condition with substantially less width.
